title: Krios Pro Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Klim Krios Pro Matte Black is crafted for all-terrain explorers transitioning from tarmac to rugged single-track, bridging highway aero efficiency with rugged off-road ventilation. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1339g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~88 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Premium carbon ADV helmet with Transitions photochromic shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Matte Black finish; Adventure/Dual Sport design.

technical_analysis: Features Hand-laid Karbonite Carbon Fiber shell construction optimized for extreme adventure dual-sport touring paired with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor. The interior utilizes Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Klim Krios Pro Matte Black: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor and Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Klim's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Krios Pro Matte Black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Klim Krios Pro Matte Black represents Klim's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Klim Krios Pro Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
